selection: Single D0 selector and frozen rankings shared across horizons. Bounded population standard deviation, exact nearest-D0 distance, or uniform random permutation; independent fixed tie stream. No future safety labels.
distance: Euclidean [theta/1, omega/3], exact nearest among all 20000 D0 pre-action states
collection: First negative raw successor margin stops rollout; crossing transition counts. Otherwise cap at H or exact remaining budget. Next initial condition follows the frozen ranking without replacement.
horizon_flags: Gym TimeLimit uses H for collection: truncated marks the collection cap, never an absorbing MDP terminal. Safety and budget stops have separate flags; evaluation always uses 200.
failure_policy: Abort on nonfinite data, simulator failure, pool exhaustion, or failed checks; preserve partial artifacts, never substitute candidates or exclude a seed.
bootstrap: Unchanged N whole-episode draws with replacement; D0 episode boundaries unchanged; ragged episodes retained; transition-mean normalized raw-action MSE; whole-episode OOB checkpoint selection.
pairing: Master-derived pool, selector, retraining, ties, random, and environment streams. Shared initialization/bootstrap/shuffle seeds across conditions; unequal episode counts imply different sampled episode IDs. Candidate-specific environment seeds shared across horizons.
deployment: Mean of five individually clipped member torques; retain raw member outputs, raw mean, bounded/raw disagreement, and saturation strata.

evaluation.safety: All 201 raw unwrapped visited states, including terminal successor: min(1-abs(theta), 1-abs(omega)/3); no angle wrapping or plotting clips. Policy inputs retain canonical D0 observation convention.

inference.interval: Marginal 95% percentile seed-bootstrap intervals; sample SD ddof=1; ranges and all paired seed values; secondary comparisons descriptive.

coverage.phases: First 20 vs later observed transitions. No imputation after horizon or safety stopping.
coverage.weighting: Both transition-weighted and equal-trajectory summaries, per-trajectory and per-step counts, distance distributions, tails, and new occupied bins.

selection_diagnostics: Per queried initial condition: bounded/raw disagreement, support distance, all strategy ranks (1-based), score distribution, cutoff, fraction with exactly zero bounded disagreement, positive-score pool exhaustion, and query order. Random has no numerical acquisition score.

safety_audit.scope: Union of selected initial conditions across all six conditions; audit each unique candidate once through first raw crossing or step 200, after all acquisition/training/evaluation are frozen.
safety_audit.late_violation_denominator: H20 trajectories safely stopped at exactly the horizon; exclude safety stops and partial budget cutoffs.
safety_audit.late_violation_numerator: Those safely capped trajectories whose first expert violation occurs at steps 21 through 200 inclusive.
safety_audit.isolation: Separate files and costs; no audit labels or continuation transitions enter selection, training, or checkpoint selection. Hash frozen datasets and checkpoints before and after.

cost_accounting: Record simulator reset/step times and attempts, collection elapsed time, and C_lambda=B+lambda*resets. Separate acquisition, technical replays, policy evaluation, and post-selection expert-audit costs. Equal transition budgets are not equal operating costs.
pilot_checks: All exact prefixes independently replayed; shared-candidate physical prefixes match; every checkpoint reloads; H200 matches accepted seed-41 data and models; full-configuration first-member replay in all six primary-budget arms; repeated primary evaluation and isolated expert audit; all existing tracked sources and prior results unchanged.
